title: Broodmother's Revenge

sources.title: Venomous Revenge
markers: | description = Whenever the wearer is healed, their weapon becomes coated in magic and deals an additional {{DamageText|1d6|Poison}}  damage.

summary: When you are healed, your weapon gains a coating that deals an extra 1d6 Poison damage for 3 turns.

fields.Effect: Healing coats melee and ranged weapons for 3 turns, adding 1d6 Poison damage on hit. Thrown attacks do not apply the bonus.
fields.Healing triggers: Can trigger at full health or when revived from Downed. Continuous regeneration and some equipment healing trigger it, while many self-healing weapons and items do not.
fields.Stacking: Dipped in Fire and Venomous Revenge overwrite each other. A weapon with an existing coating blocks Venomous Revenge, and applying a coating replaces it.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and pinned evidence, then refined its mechanics against item and linked rule notes.
